axes_source: Read from data/brands/ikea.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #0058A3 and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #111111 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #FFDB00; density from its 8px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 8, 16px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion from its stated durations 6000ms, 800ms, 200ms, 150ms; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
